fusions.name: Autumn Gorging
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rolling Maul
fusions.desc: A crushing roll that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brumation
fusions.desc: You go still and restore 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Full-Bellied Fury
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
